prompts.empire-hostile:
LIVE: the Empire is hostile and raiding.
1. game_pause_game first, then game_list_colonists.
2. game_set_draft every armed shooter; order_pawn them into the embrasure room between base and enemy.
3. Ranged first, fall back while firing so melee never closes.
4. Shielded cataphracts: EMP grenades if count_weapon_grenadeemp>0, else focus fire one at a time.
5. Order refused: re-issue to the next embrasure cell; still refused -> everyone behind turrets.
6. Done = hostiles_on_map 0 (the rung stops by itself); undraft.
prompts.title-track:
LIVE: a colonist's title changed (title_seniority != mark title_seniority).
1. ladder: read title_seniority.
2. Map it with TITLE_RANK_TABLE (100 Freeholder=1 ... 700 Count=7).
3. ladder_set mark title_seniority <value>; ladder_set mark title_rank <n>; ladder_set mark psylink_level <n>.
4. ladder_set mark title_tracked true.
Fallback: title unreadable -> game_list_colonists, read the title from the pawn.
Done = mark title_seniority equals the sensor.
prompts.empire-quest:
LIVE: a new Empire quest letter.
1. game_list_letters -> game_open_letter.
2. Honor in the reward AND fight_ratio>=QUEST_MIN_FIGHT_RATIO -> accept; else dismiss.
3. Quest pawn = nearest the next title, never the only doctor.
4. Accept refused: game_get_ui_layout, click Accept by name; still nothing -> game_dismiss_letter.
5. Done = ladder_set mark empire_quest_active true.
Never: send the only doctor away.
